storage: The GWAS files are not stored in this repository. The notebook downloads them and checks the SHA-256 checksums below.

BMI.study: Yengo et al. 2018, Hum Mol Genet 27:3641-3649
BMI.design: Meta-analysis of GIANT (Locke et al. 2015) and UK Biobank; European ancestry; about 700,000 people
BMI.columns: CHR POS SNP Tested_Allele Other_Allele Freq_Tested_Allele_in_HRS BETA SE P N; Tested_Allele is the effect allele
BMI.notes: Byte-identical to the file on the GIANT consortium data page (same SHA-256); the GWAS Catalog copy is used because the GIANT site was unreachable on 2026-10-29.

TG.design: Global Lipids Genetics Consortium joint analysis of GWAS and Metabochip data; 188,578 people of European ancestry in the paper; N per SNP 50,000-178,000 in this file
TG.build: GRCh37 positions in SNP_hg19 (chr:pos); rsid used for matching
TG.columns: SNP_hg18 SNP_hg19 rsid A1 A2 beta se N P-value Freq.A1.1000G.EUR; A1 is the effect allele and always the TG-raising allele (all beta >= 0); alleles in lower case
TG.notes: Genomic control was applied to each study and again to the meta-analysis (Willer et al. 2013, Methods); the consortium page states that P-values are after genomic control. Here, chi-square from beta/se is 11-12% larger than chi-square from P-value at the median; the practical uses beta/se. 1,160 rows share 183 rsIDs.

DBP.design: Discovery meta-analysis of UK Biobank and ICBP, about 750,000 people of European ancestry; blood pressure analysed adjusted for age, age squared, sex and BMI. Before the meta-analysis, UK Biobank statistics were divided by their LDSC intercept (1.219 for DBP) and ICBP studies were corrected for genomic control (Evangelou et al. 2018, Methods); the authors note the potential for collider bias from the BMI adjustment.
DBP.columns: MarkerName Allele1 Allele2 Freq1 Effect StdErr P TotalSampleSize N_effective; Allele1 is the effect allele; Effect in mmHg; N_effective is N times imputation quality
DBP.notes: No rsIDs; the practical splits MarkerName into chromosome and position and matches by position.

ld_reference.description: HapMap3 regression SNPs with 1000 Genomes Phase 3 EUR LD scores (1 cM windows), as published for LD Score regression.
ld_reference.long_range_ld_note: load_ld_reference('hm3-eur') leaves out the variants in allelign's GRCh37 long-range LD regions, including the MHC, by default; n_variants counts the full bundle.
